scripts.test: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-workphone --only auth,firestore,storage "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/**/*.test.mjs"
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-workphone
scripts.release: git pull && npm install && npm --prefix functions install && npm run build && firebase deploy
scripts.android:apk: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && gradlew assembleRelease && cd .. && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk','release/yangsan-support.apk')"
